# Testiniai žmonės // dago

Synthetic Lithuanian person data for testing. No real-person records.
Base URL: https://dago.lt/irankiai/testiniai-zmones/

## Fetch without JavaScript
- person.v2.json: one person object, schemaVersion 2.
- people.v2.json: array of 100 person objects, schemaVersion 2.
These are STATIC fixtures. Every request returns the same data.
Seed: dago-testiniai-zmones-v2. referenceDate: 2026-01-01.
Age is relative to referenceDate, NOT the current date.
Query parameters do not generate new people. No dynamic API exists.
Use ordinary HTTP GET. Public JSON and generator support CORS.
Legacy v1 JSON and module remain available unchanged, with placeholder
contacts and TEST- IDs. Use v2 for national IDs and real address/postcode pairs.

## Generate fresh or reproducible data
Download src/generator.v2.mjs and import it locally in Node.js 22+,
or import its absolute HTTPS URL in a browser ES module.
The published module includes the shared national-ID core and addresses;
no additional files or dependencies are required.
Exports: generatePerson(options), generatePeople(options), SCHEMA_VERSION.
Options: count (integer 1..1000, default 1; generatePeople only),
seed (string 1..200 characters, default random UUID),
referenceDate (valid YYYY-MM-DD from 1900 to 2118, default current UTC date).
For reproducible results specify both seed and referenceDate.
Version 2 returns the same values for the same options.

## Schema 2
schemaVersion: 2; isTestData: true; referenceDate: YYYY-MM-DD;
personalCode: 11-digit Lithuanian national ID (no separate id field);
firstName, lastName, fullName, gender (vyras or moteris),
birthDate (YYYY-MM-DD), age (integer 18..80), email, phone,
address: {street, city, postalCode, country, countryCode},
occupation, company.

## Validation and provenance
National ID birth date, gender and checksum match the person fields.
Uses the same core as the project's asmens-kodai tool.
National IDs are generated, not sourced from individuals, but may coincide
with issued IDs and are not guaranteed globally unique.
Phone: E.164 +3706XXXXXXX, verified as valid LT mobile format with
libphonenumber-js. Does not verify assignment, activation or SMS delivery.
Do not send messages or place calls in tests.
Address: one of 7 real public-institution street/house/city/postcode pairs.
Whole pairs are selected; house numbers are never invented or changed.
Source list checked 2026-10-06:
https://github.com/debesyla/dago-irankiai/blob/main/tools/testiniai-zmones/ADDRESS-SOURCES.md
This is a limited offline list, not a national address database or live lookup.
A particular external validator may have different or outdated data.
Names may coincidentally match real people. Emails use example.com.
Company names are fictional. No claim is made that the person lives at
that real address or owns the generated number or national ID.
If you cannot fetch the URLs, disclose that instead of fabricating a fetch.

Source: https://github.com/debesyla/dago-irankiai/tree/main/tools/testiniai-zmones
